adjudication_records.issue_text: pkg/expr/sql/db.go:20 — QueryFramesInto does not accept or honor a context.Context/timeout despite being invoked from a ctx-aware Execute path, so any future real implementation risks unbounded/non-cancelable query execution

adjudication.rationale: In this diff, `SQLCommand.Execute(ctx, ...)` is context-aware but calls `db.QueryFramesInto(...)` without passing `ctx` (pkg/expr/sql_command.go). The newly added `(*DB).QueryFramesInto` signature in pkg/expr/sql/db.go:20 has no `context.Context` parameter, so any future real DB/query implementation would have no direct way to honor cancellation/timeouts from the Execute path. Currently it just returns `errors.New("not implemented")`, so it’s not a runtime defect yet, but it is a concrete API/architecture concern introduced by the change.
